responsibility: Implements the MMIX target backend’s C-side logic and hook callbacks that connect generic GCC RTL expansion, reload, scheduling/final output, and assembler emission to MMIX-specific ABI and instruction semantics. This file owns the target hooks for option override, file and function prologue/epilogue output, thunk emission, varargs setup, libfunc initialization, register-class and move-cost decisions, address and constant legitimacy checks, argument and return-value handling, frame-pointer and struct-value conventions, section/symbol encoding, post-reload reorganization, and helper routines that print MMIX-specific constants, conditions, and data directives for assembly, complementing the declarative instruction patterns in mmix.md and macros in mmix.h.
same_name_distinction: C implementation file for the MMIX backend: it defines the target-hook functions, helper routines, and assembly-output logic referenced by the port, whereas mmix.h provides the target macros and shared declarations, mmix.md supplies the RTL machine-description patterns and templates, and mmix.opt declares the MMIX-specific command-line options.
